Members of Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) hold a protest at the corner of Kalaw Avenue and Roxas Boulevard in Manila after police blocked their march toward the U.S. Embassy on Friday, February 6, 2026.
 
The group called for an end to alleged U.S. aggression in Venezuela and the continuing "genocide" in Palestine, while also demanding the dismantling of Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement (EDCA) sites and the removal of foreign troops from the country. | via Maria Tan, ABS-CBN News
